findings.issue: Itinerary data flow incomplete before this commit
findings.description: Admin form had no UI to create/edit itinerary days, so the field always saved as empty array. Fix: new ItineraryEditor component now allows full CRUD on itinerary days.

Trip schema defines the field but createTrip and updateTrip never filled it, leaving per-date seat tracking broken. Fix: both functions now calculate and populate seatsByStartDate from startDates and availableSeats.

findings.issue: Date picker showed all dates as available
findings.description: Date selector iterated over startDates without checking availability, disabling sold-out dates. Fix: date picker now calls getSeatsForDate per date and disables/labels sold-out options.
